label: Retained readings from Ludwig Wittgenstein, Logisch-philosophische Abhandlung / Tractatus Logico-Ph
summary: TLP 6.44, Nicht wie die Welt ist, ist das Mystische, sondern dass sie ist: Tractatus 6.44 supplies the contrast between how the world is and that it is in docs/wittgenstein.md. It remains context for the discussion of the mystical. Applying it to the case needs a separate inference from that contrast to an intelligible claim about the world or God.
